sections.heading: Legal documents
sections.body: Perú Grand Travel Group S.A.C. is a legally registered business fulfilling all the norms and requisites determined by the Peruvian government. Our company pays income tax called IGV which at the moment is 18% as well as paying a yearly tax of 30% on our annual earnings. Our taxes are carefully monitored and paid for by our accountant. We never try to avoid paying taxes as we are a responsible and professional company that accepts the responsibility to directly contribute to the Peruvian economy. Since 2020, we donate a % of our earnings on community development projects, however this has been delayed until 2023 due to the Covid 19 pandemic. We are completely conscious of the fact that a large number of indigenous communities suffer from extreme poverty and we need to help in any way we can, as our social responsibility.
